tasks.short: Monitor indications and crossing traffic for hazards

steps.what: Monitor lights indicating obstructions or trains ahead
Watch car and truck traffic at crossings
Assess potential hazards and maintain attention as conditions change
outputs: ongoing operator awareness of potential hazards

tasks.design: Retain continuous indication and crossing observation as human operating work. Existing native displays in {OPS_SYSTEM} provide indications but do not remove the operator's attention or situational assessment.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires continuous perception of actual traffic and changing indications.
tasks.enabler_now: No new software substitution supported by this digest removes that attention.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising potential hazards in the actual crossing and route context.
tasks.altitude: Keep the live monitoring work fully retained.

reach.learn: Evaluate indications with the actual surroundings

evidence.claim: The digest's rail paperwork opportunities do not establish software savings for continuous crossing and indication monitoring.

assumptions: All live observation and hazard assessment are included. This task states no record write or report; the actual delay and hazard reporting, including a written note where made, is explicitly priced in12770.

Existing signalling equipment produces the indications, while the operator produces direct traffic observations in s1-s2 with all observation time counted. No structured safe-crossing or obstruction code is assumed for automation.
Native displays, templates or settings do not replace these actions. There is no hidden clerical lookup, record write or machine alert in this zero.
No new software or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Whether any separate monitoring log is actually written
research_questions: Does observation of the live episode reveal any separately performed clerical action?

already_counted.description: All indication observation, crossing observation and hazard assessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Both cases retain continuous observation and situational assessment. Existing indication displays are already today's means and offer no new saving; an actual separate record would require its own measured allocation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report delays, mechanical problems and emergencies by radio

steps.what: Establish observed delay, mechanical problem or emergency facts
Select report content and clarify uncertain details
Report the checked event to supervisors or dispatchers by radio
Confirm acknowledgement and clarify follow-up questions
Write the existing event and radio-report note

tasks.design: Keep urgent radio reporting in {TELEPHONY} human. Configure a concise existing event-note layout in {OPS_SYSTEM} or {DOCS}; the written record is separately priced after the radio exchange and does not delay it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing event notes repeat basic headings after the operator has given the radio report.
tasks.enabler_now: Native note fields can reduce a small amount of writing repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Reporting uncertain live facts clearly and responding to the dispatcher's questions.
tasks.human_edge: Accurate immediate communication in the real operating context.
tasks.altitude: A clearer supporting record without replacing the radio exchange.

reach.learn: Separate observed facts from uncertain cause

evidence.claim: The digest identifies incident-report paperwork as a rail opportunity; native event-note savings here remain E1 and do not automate urgent radio reports.
The digest describes separate company incident reporting to ILT; a radio report to dispatch is not that regulatory submission.

assumptions: Scenario includes the operator's existing event note where made; verify this baseline rather than creating a new log. Regulatory filing is the company's separate workflow and no external submission is silently performed.

Operator produces direct event facts in s1 and report points in s2; after acknowledgement, s5 captures vehicle or trip, time, location, observed problem, uncertainty and report recipient. Capture and checking time are retained. Missing facts are marked unknown and clarified manually; no structured fault or emergency code is assumed.
Use native note headings first; no voice transcription, automatic cause classification, alert or machine send is proposed.
Same-system author saves remain fully retained within s5, with no self-approval.
unknowns: Whether the operator writes a separate event note
Division between operator and dispatch record creation
research_questions: Can native note fields reduce follow-up writing while preserving uncertain facts and the radio-report recipient?

approvals.approved_version: Exact observed event, stated uncertainty and current radio recipient checked immediately before reporting; changed details require a renewed check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R97 gross3 less1 upkeep gives central2. Low retains14/15 note writing when most narrative is unique: gross1 less1=0. High retains13/15 notes with useful event headings and known trip references: gross2 less1=1. Observation, report judgement, actual radio transmission and acknowledgement remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Make passenger stop and delay announcements

steps.what: Check upcoming stop, trip and current delay information
Select and enter announcement wording from current information
Check exact passenger announcement, timing and destination audience
Broadcast the exact checked passenger announcement
Monitor announcement playback and changed passenger-information needs
Deliver checked corrective or exceptional announcements to passengers

tasks.design: Configure supported announcement templates and playback in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The operator captures current context, enters the message and checks its exact version; a separate machine broadcast uses only that payload, while playback monitoring and exceptional messages remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Where announcements are spoken manually today, repeated wording and delivery consume operator effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stored messages and playback can replace repetitive speaking after an exact-version check.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate current information, unusual disruption and whether passengers understood the message.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a routine announcement is inadequate or wrong.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repetitive announcement delivery while retaining current-information judgement.

reach.learn: Distinguish confirmed information from an estimate

evidence.claim: Native stored announcements and checked playback are a plausible E1 design; the digest supplies no measured passenger-announcement case.

assumptions: This scenario applies only to announcements still spoken manually today. Stops already announced automatically offer zero new benefit; do not count their existing runtime as saving.

Dispatcher produces current disruption information in their operational record, whose existing capture stays with that producer. Operator captures route, trip, current stop, verified delay wording, source version and checked-at time in s1, and the exact message and audience in s2; all capture is priced. Missing or conflicting context requires a manual announcement and stops playback.
Native approved messages and playback settings come first; no model chooses stops, infers delay, triggers an announcement from an unproduced flag or invents travel advice.
The machine broadcasts only the payload checked in s3; changed content, timing or audience invalidates the gate. No implicit record fill or extra send is proposed.
unknowns: Reliability of current stop and disruption information
research_questions: Can checked native playback reduce speaking time without stale, mistimed or wrong-route messages?

incremental.description: Maintain message templates and test playback controls

approvals.approved_version: Exact immutable message payload, current trip, audience and playback time checked in s3; any changed field invalidates approval and blocks playback
Exact corrective statement and current verified context checked immediately before speaking; changed information requires another check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R60 gross40 less3 upkeep gives central37 for currently manual announcements only. Low retains19/20 context,19/20 wording and27/30 speaking because most notices are exceptional or native templates do not fit: gross5 less3=2. High retains16/20 context,14/20 wording and15/30 speaking with supported messages covering a substantial ordinary subset: gross25 less3=22. Exact-version checking, monitoring and corrective speech remain full. Already automatic announcements have no new eligible saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess the actual emergency and passenger circumstances
Determine applicable evacuation direction within the operator's authority
Direct emergency evacuation and communicate current instructions to passengers
Monitor evacuation progress and assist as circumstances change
Communicate current evacuation status to the dispatcher

tasks.design: Retain emergency assessment, direction, assistance and live status communication as human work. Existing emergency instructions and {TELEPHONY} support the operator; a template or native view does not replace directing people in the actual situation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evacuation direction depends on immediate conditions and the passengers present.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software substitution removes this live responsibility.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to changing circumstances and passengers needing help.
tasks.altitude: Keep live emergency direction fully retained.

reach.learn: Maintain clear current communication and attend to individual needs

evidence.claim: The digest's reporting and rostering tools do not establish a software saving for live emergency evacuation direction.

assumptions: Includes live direction and dispatcher handoff. The operator's actual event-report note is separately priced in12770 s5; count a shared incident record once. No evacuation-plan write, status record or regulator send is hidden inside a conversation here.

Operator produces actual situation observations in s1 and progress observations in s4, with full time counted. Dispatcher produces their own operational record during dispatch work; no structured safe-exit, completed-evacuation or passenger-status flag is assumed for automation.
Native instruction access or communication settings cannot remove live judgement and assistance. Any separately observed clerical action needs its own price before changing this zero.
No new software or maintenance is introduced.
unknowns: Local authority and division of emergency roles
Whether the operator writes an additional distinct evacuation record
research_questions: Is there a distinct record-writing action beyond the incident note already priced in12770?

already_counted.description: All assessment, decisions, direction, assistance and status handoff

approvals.approved_version: Exact current directions checked against observed conditions immediately before communicating; changed circumstances require a renewed check
Exact observed status, remaining concerns and dispatcher recipient checked before the handoff; changes require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Both cases retain live emergency judgement, direction, assistance and status handoff. Record-writing effort is explicitly owned by the reporting task and is not treated as unsaveable conversation time here.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain live operating and emergency judgement while reducing repetitive information delivery and actual record handling.
reach: More explicit event records and handoffs
role.ambitious_version: A transit operator with reliable supporting information and more attention available for passengers and live conditions.
